meta.label: TypeSafe Jev reranker
meta.description: Jev as a Reranking model for Knowledge Bank search and retrieval-augmented LLMs. Each document gets a yes/no relevance question; its probability of yes is the relevance score.

params.name: model
params.label: Jev version
params.description: jev-latest moves with new releases. Pin a version such as jev-1.13.0 once you have tuned thresholds on it.

params.name: cost_per_million_input_tokens
params.label: Cost per million input tokens ($)
params.description: For LLM Mesh cost tracking. TypeSafe charges input tokens only. Adjust to your contract.

params.name: sep_rerank
params.label: Relevance question
params.description: Asked about {query, document} for every retrieved document.

params.name: rerank_instructions
params.label: Question
params.defaultValue: Does the document contain information that answers the query?

params.name: rerank_true
params.label: What counts as yes
params.defaultValue: The document directly answers the query or gives facts needed to answer it.

params.name: rerank_false
params.label: What counts as no
params.defaultValue: The document is off-topic or only shares keywords with the query.
